_classes.name: sunset extension of an earlier chapter with no stored and no dropped record
_classes.rule: packet LAW TEXT matches r'(expire|deemed repealed)[^.]{0,200}\[[^\]]{1,40}\]\s*\{\{[^}]{1,40}\}\}' and matter_id has no row in duties, powers or dropped (law-level count; includes packets not yet answered)

_classes.name: effective date: 'N years after it shall have become a law' section proviso misassigned (known parser gap, recurrence)
_classes.rule: effective_dates raw_clause matches r'(sections?[^;]{0,80}?) shall take effect (one|two|...|\d+) years? after it shall have become a law' and a section_dates.applies_to inside that group has rule != years_after_law; count records of those laws with effective_rule section_section

_classes.name: penalty on a private person stored as a court duty
_classes.rule: quote matches r'shall be punished by|punishable by a fine|guilty of a (misdemeanor|violation|class)' (case-insensitive)

_classes.name: record whose only braced matter in the quote span is punctuation or a gender-neutral word (reprint; fixed Oct 17, recurrence)
_classes.rule: locate quote in packet text with [deleted] removed; every braced run inside the quote span matches ^(,|;|:|their|them|they|the commissioner|the applicant|such person|the|a|an|some|which|or|and)?$; record_source empty

_classes.name: approval condition added to a reprinted power stored as an extension
_classes.rule: extends_existing true and quote matches r'upon (the )?approval (by|of)'

_classes.name: appointment to a newly created seat with deadline none instead of on_effective_date
_classes.rule: kind duty, deliverable_type 'designation or staffing', deadline_kind none, extends_existing false, quote matches r'shall appoint' and not r'vacanc'
